assumptions.activation: experimental lane only; explicit opt-in per call; no frozen-core field is written
assumptions.aggregation: none; the two arithmetic means of card F02 are outside this contract
assumptions.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64; math.pow, math.exp and math.sqrt of the host C library
assumptions.evaluation_form: the direct expression of card F02; the logarithmic form is not used
assumptions.identity: result_id = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the document without result_id
assumptions.membership: exactly one explicitly declared pair; no pair is discovered, ordered or combined
assumptions.parameters: c, eta and kappa are explicit in the payload; no global, environment or default value
assumptions.underflow: a quantity strictly positive in exact arithmetic that evaluates to 0.0 is rejected, not carried
assumptions.units: declared units are compared, never converted; card F02 defines no conversion rule

formulation.source_card: astra math formulation, section 3, card F02
